entities.name: Avenant
entities.description: A plains-covered island matriarchy off the coast of Aerona on Dominaria, one of the Seven Great Houses of Benalia.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane on which Avenant lies.

entities.name: Aerona
entities.description: Land just off whose coast Avenant lies.

entities.name: Benalia
entities.description: Mainland nation south of Avenant, of which Avenant is one of the Seven Great Houses.

entities.name: Bardic Circle
entities.description: Avenant's circle of poets, writers of the popular Avanaise poetry.

entities.name: Suzeraine
entities.description: The title of Avenant's ruler; the eldest daughter is in line to wear the Wreath.

entities.name: Clan Joryev
entities.description: A Benalish clan whose unwise leader is said to have insulted Avenant.

entities.name: Clan Ternsev
entities.description: A Benalish clan, once the seventh Great House, replaced by Avenant.

entities.name: Cerise D'Avenant
entities.description: Current head of House Avenant, who attends the Council of Seven personally.

entities.name: Council of Seven
entities.description: Council of the Seven Great Houses of Benalia.

events.summary: Avenant is lost to Benalia after an insult by an unwise clan leader (said by some to be a Clan Ternsev leader who kidnapped an Avenant prince's daughter).
events.quote: Avenant once formed a part of Benalia, but it was lost after an insult by an unwise clan leader

events.summary: In the Mending Era Avenant rejoins Benalia, replacing Clan Ternsev as the seventh Great House.
events.quote: replacing Clan Ternsev as the seventh Great House

relations.note: One of the Seven Great Houses of Benalia.
relations.quote: Avenant has been one of the Seven Great Houses of Benalia since the Mending Era
The current head of the house, Cerise D'Avenant

relations.note: Island just off the coast of Aerona.
relations.quote: just off the coast of Aerona
